# Universal Financial Calculator - llms.txt
# https://universal-financial-calculator.vercel.app

> Universal Financial Calculator is a free, all-in-one financial calculator suite providing tools for loans, mortgages, investments, retirement planning, tax estimation, and more. Available in English and Korean.

## Calculators

### Loan & Mortgage
- Mortgage Calculator: Monthly payments, total interest, amortization schedules
- Auto Loan Calculator: Car financing calculations with trade-in values
- Personal Loan Calculator: Unsecured loan payment estimations
- Student Loan Calculator: Education financing with repayment plans

### Investment & Savings
- Compound Interest Calculator: Future value projections with regular contributions
- Investment Return Calculator: ROI, CAGR, and portfolio growth analysis
- Savings Goal Calculator: Time and monthly savings needed to reach targets
- Dollar Cost Averaging Calculator: DCA strategy analysis for stocks and crypto

### Retirement Planning
- Retirement Calculator: Projected retirement savings and income
- 401(k) Calculator: Employer match optimization
- IRA Calculator: Traditional vs Roth IRA comparison
- Social Security Estimator: Benefit projections

### Tax & Income
- Income Tax Calculator: Federal and state tax estimation
- Capital Gains Tax Calculator: Investment tax impact analysis
- Paycheck Calculator: Net pay after deductions
- Self-Employment Tax Calculator: Freelancer tax obligations

### Business & Real Estate
- ROI Calculator: Business investment return analysis
- Break-Even Calculator: Sales volume for profitability
- Rental Property Calculator: Real estate investment returns
- Net Worth Calculator: Personal financial snapshot

## Languages
- English (en) - Primary
- Korean (ko) - Full translation

## Technical Details
- Client-side calculations (no data sent to servers)
- Mobile-responsive design
- Progressive Web App support
- Accessible (WCAG 2.1 compliant)

## Structured Data
- JSON-LD: WebApplication, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList schemas
- Open Graph and Twitter Card metadata
- Speakable markup for voice assistants
